state_change_proposals: Millrace the 298th evening; departure dawn the 299th; twelve and a mule; cash ~125 (the ford-keeper's night).

ORYN'S TERMS restated at Millrace: three holds north still owed (four walked since the fork); the old woman at Thornwater; 'a stop on my own route'; she walks east two days on her way and further for the ribs and for the cost of two Quiet places; turns north the day she has to; nobody asks her not to. Teague heard it.

THE DEEP READING (Oryn, Tide, the long one, at Millrace's bench): the still place unchanged since the autumn; nothing for a healer to read; everything round it; she can now read all TWELVE currents to the bank; she knows one of the two new ones is 'not for fighting' and will not ask. Her finding certain (fixed line).

CAEL'S PRIVATE FINDING (the twelfth turned inward, unbidden): the still place reads STILL, then SET — 'the inside of a made thing' — a lean with no bearer/borne; no word; withheld from Oryn (Cleon's warning; no guess; her finding is hers). UNRESOLVED; two instruments disagree.

Injuries: Brom's shoulder 'a shoulder' (carry with the other another month); Lira's arm 'an arm' (forty days); Karis's hand rebound with linen ('It'll leave a line'; a week off writing — not obeyed); Vastin's knee held in the cut — 'the month's the month', eleven more days on the stick (day 20 on the road). Vastin uses 'Noted' ('It's his.').
Oryn poured the pan out; she has NOT heard the leaf ('Tell me on the road, if there's road. Not at my table.').
The map: the straightedge's pencil line drawn from the fourth circle out onto the blank sheet to the divider's point and past it. Oryn's roll on the mule beside Karis's boxes.
The two healers: one look; complete.
deviations: Closer is the image as carded; no log this chapter.
